archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST ESG ANALYTICS

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scales.h2_question_title: text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-950 md:text-xl leading-snug

visual_enhancers.borders_and_radius: Rounded-xl for outer cards, rounded-lg for sub-elements, concentric inner padding p-4 to p-6.
visual_enhancers.question_badge: Inverted rounded-full circle icon with bold white number on vibrant pillar background or sky blue background
visual_enhancers.mcq_distribution_bar: Animated percentage fill bars with supplier response highlighted using ring-2 ring-emerald-500 and distinct badge

grids_and_layouts.main_panel_stack: space-y-6 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm p-6

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Redesign SupplierResponseReviewPage.jsx: Enhance top header with colorful ESG pillar stat blocks (Environment, Social, Governance) in vibrant cards, supplier and questionnaire metadata cards with clear icons, and responsive tab buttons.

2. Redesign ResponseReviewSidebar.jsx: Upgrade taxonomy navigation with pillar badges, progress pill counters for category reviewed ratios, active category state with left accent bar and colored icons.
3. Redesign ResponseReviewQuestionPanel.jsx to match screenshot density and color alignment:
a) Question header with circular numbered badge (e.g. ①) and title, plus question type tags.
b) Supplier Response card: Styled option choices or formatted text answer with vibrant 'Submitted' status badge.
c) Evidence preview block: File container showing PDF icon, original filename, file size, upload timestamp, and bright Preview / Download buttons.
d) Scoring Guidance block: High-visibility electric blue / sky gradient card displaying points criteria per option or rule.
- Status choices for Accept (emerald), Needs Clarification (amber), Reject (rose) with radio-style button cards.
- Reviewer Score input with '/ max_points' label.
- Reviewer Comment textarea with character count indicator (e.g. 132/500).
- CTAs: 'Save Review' (primary button) and 'Save & Next ->' (accent button that saves review and advances to next question).
f) Footer and top navigation bar with Previous and Next question controls.

4. Redesign ResponseAnswerHistory.jsx: Vertical timeline with connected line, color-coded event icons (v1 submission, reviewer feedback, v2 supplier revision, final decision), author tags, answer snapshots, and timestamp details.

5. Implement OtherResponsesDistribution.jsx component (or include within sidebar/panel): Visual percentage distribution bars for MCQ questions showing peer supplier response proportions, clearly labeling '(Supplier's response)' on the supplier's selection.
6. Ensure all existing data hooks, API calls (save review, open evidence, fetch response), and test IDs (data-testid) are strictly maintained.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid to every interactive button, input, tab, badge, and section container.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.file_format: Use JS / JSX components strictly. Do not create TS/TSX files.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure high text contrast against tinted card backgrounds. Interactive buttons must have clear focus rings.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Smooth transition-colors and hover effects on decision buttons, file download cards, and category items.
